name: logs
description: Agent-friendly log + telemetry sink. CLI + MCP + HTTP API (logs-serve) + generated SDK. Local mode uses SQLite at ~/.hasna/logs/logs.db; cloud mode (HASNA_LOGS_STORAGE_MODE=cloud) is PURE REMOTE per Amendment A1: the serve process reads/writes the shared cloud Postgres directly, with API-key auth via @hasna/contracts. This is the shared S3-backed log sink other apps route to.
